one_line: Late Ganga king and Rashtrakuta feudatory of Gangavadi, remembered as a powerful general and Jain ruler associated with sallekhana at Bankapura.

appearance.age_look: early 40s, lean but strong build, medium-tall and wiry
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose and full lips, warm medium-brown complexion, sharp dark eyes with thick brows, a neatly kept short moustache, and a calm, resolute default expression that mixes royal authority with inward focus.
appearance.hair: Black hair parted at the center, pulled back into a tight low knot at the nape wrapped with a narrow gold band, with a few controlled strands by the temples and a simple cloth under-band like a subdued turban base.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate late 10th-century Western Ganga royal outfit: a knee-length off-white cotton angavastra-style tunic with narrow sleeves, worn under a rich deep-red silk uttariya draped from the left shoulder across the torso and around the waist, paired with mustard-gold dhoti-style lower garment pleated in front and tied high at the waist, a broad brown leather war-belt with simple brass fittings, plain but sturdy dark-brown leather sandals, minimal but royal jewellery including a medium-thick gold necklace with a single flat pendant, two slim gold armlets on each upper arm, simple gold bangles, and small round gold earrings; fabric is mostly plain weave with a subtle narrow geometric border pattern in maroon and black along the edges of the uttariya and dhoti.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved steel sword (early sabre-like form) with a simple iron hilt wrapped in dark leather and a plain round pommel, sheathed in a brown leather scabbard that hangs from his belt on the left hip.

ref_desc: Marasimha II Satyavakya is a lean, medium-brown man in his early 40s with sharp dark eyes, short moustache, black hair tied in a low knot with a gold band, wearing an off-white tunic, deep-red silk uttariya, mustard-gold dhoti, brown belt and sandals, modest gold jewellery, and carrying a curved steel sword in a brown leather scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Marasimha II Satyavakya: a lean, medium-tall, medium-brown skinned man in his early 40s with an oval face, sharp dark eyes, thick brows, straight nose, full lips, and a calm, resolute expression; he has a neatly kept short moustache and black hair parted at the center, pulled back into a tight low knot at the nape wrapped with a narrow gold band, with a few controlled strands near the temples and a simple cloth under-band. Dress him in a historically accurate late 10th-century Western Ganga royal outfit from Gangavadi and Manyakheta: a knee-length off-white cotton tunic with narrow sleeves; over it a rich deep-red silk uttariya draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the waist; a mustard-gold dhoti-style lower garment pleated in front and tied high at the waist; a broad brown leather war-belt with simple brass fittings; and plain, sturdy dark-brown leather sandals. Add minimal but royal jewellery: a medium-thick gold necklace with a single flat pendant, slim gold armlets on each upper arm, simple gold bangles, and small round gold earrings; show subtle narrow geometric border patterns in maroon and black along the edges of the uttariya and dhoti while keeping most fabric plain. His signature weapon is a long, slightly curved steel sword with a simple iron hilt wrapped in dark leather and a plain round pommel, sheathed in a brown leather scabbard hanging from his belt on the left hip. Use a palette dominated by deep red, off-white, mustard gold, dark brown, and his warm medium-brown skin tone, and present him in neutral, front and slight angle poses suitable for consistent redrawing.
